verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of overage fee schedules, per-unit pricing for exceeding bandwidth/invocations/build-minute limits, or any billing transparency docs — only unrelated product/feature docs and community commentary (e.g., a complaint about surprise bills, vercel-comm-12) that actually undercuts predictability rather than supporting it. This axis is applicable to a usage-based PaaS but no evidence shows Vercel delivers it.
